_README: One Pin package per article. Images are generated by `python tools/make_pins.py` into pinterest-pins/<article>/. pool: initial (scheduled launch pool) | reserve (kept as later creative variations, no date). board = one of the 5 launch boards; laterSeasonalBoard = where to also save it once that seasonal board exists. Status: draft -> ready (reviewed by Intesar) -> published (posted by hand, add pinUrl). Never auto-post. Soft launch: no product promises, prices, 'shop the look' or affiliate wording.

pins.headline: Why your press-ons pop off
pins.title: Why Your Press-Ons Pop Off (and How to Fix It)
pins.description: Press-on nails popping off in a day or two? It's usually prep and fit, not the glue. Find your symptom and the fix.
pins.altText: Text graphic listing common press-on nail problems with their quick fixes.
items: Pops off in days: re-prep, thin glue, hold
Lifts at the cuticle: keep it off the skin
Hurts at the sides: check width and curve
Gaps: match the curve to your nail
pins.aiDisclosure: Original text graphic; no AI imagery.

pins.headline: Where did it lift?
pins.title: Where Did It Lift? A Press-On Diagnosis Chart
pins.description: Lifting at the cuticle, the sides or popping off whole? Where your press-on fails tells you why. Save this diagnosis chart.
pins.altText: Text chart matching where a press-on lifts to its likely cause.
items: At the cuticle: glue pooled or tip on skin
At the sides: oil left in the grooves, or overhang
Whole nail pops off: prep or size
pins.aiDisclosure: Original text graphic; no AI imagery.

pins.headline: Do your press-ons hurt?
pins.title: Do Your Press-Ons Hurt? Too Wide vs Too Narrow
pins.description: Side pain from press-on nails can mean the tip is too wide or too narrow, and the fixes are opposite. Here's how to tell which.
pins.altText: Text graphic comparing a press-on that is too wide with one that is too narrow.
items: Too wide: it sits on skin and lifts
Too narrow: it pinches the sidewalls
Too curved: pressure on flat nails
pins.aiDisclosure: Original text graphic; no AI imagery.

pins.headline: UV gel glue under press-ons?
pins.title: Is UV Gel Glue Safe Under Press-Ons? Read This First
pins.description: UV gel glue may not fully cure under opaque press-on tips because light can't reach it, and uncured gel increases the risk of an allergy. A sourced safety note before you try the hack.
pins.altText: Text safety note about UV gel glue under opaque press-on tips.
items: Light may not reach glue under opaque tips
Uncured gel increases the risk of allergy
A gel allergy is usually lifelong
pins.aiDisclosure: Original text graphic; no AI imagery.
